Assembling the Wrinkeler…

How the puppet was built

Source → joints → rough test → lofted bellows

5 · What this build changes

  • The bellows is now real geometry. Twenty-seven cross-section rings are lofted along a bowed 3D spine and skinned with ~340 quads — ridge rings swell, valley rings pinch, and the whole tube is closed, so there is a genuine back wall behind the front pleats.
  • Depth-sorted, back-face-culled, and lit from upper-left by a real surface normal, so the top planes of every fold catch light and the valleys occlude properly as the body squeezes.
  • Limbs are socketed, not floated. Hips are sampled off the actual underside of the bellows each frame and covered by a pelvis yoke; arms run housing socket → piston shaft → wrist ball → fist, with capping discs over every seam.
  • The gait plants its feet. Stance feet are locked to the ground in world space (no sliding), with heel-strike impact dip, weight roll onto the stance leg, and a squeeze of the bellows per stride — it plays itself as it marches.
  • Three attacks — Jab, Crush Chord, Reed Blast — all driven through the same bellows: air is the weapon, and the concept's orange sound arcs are the payload.
